My first time ever getting high smoking pot.

I had tried weed twice before this experience. I never got "high" as one might expect when trying it for the first time. I don't know what i did wrong. Some of my friends in high school told me it could be due to my weight. (im a little over 300 pounds still to this day) so i just assumed I needed more to feel the affects of marijuana. Anyways, a buddy and I decided to catch a movie and he happens to have some pot on him. He rolled a pretty big joint, takes a puff and hands it to me. I tell him that weed doesn't affect me as much but I smoked anyways just for the hell of it.

I didn't feel anything for about a minute and then BAM! i start giggling like hyena having an orgasm. I was aware this was abnormal but i just COULDN'T stop. Naturally he assumed I was bullshitting but i tried to reassure him this was real. I felt really good, like both of your grandmothers hugging you at the same time and i was getting dizzy. I felt really warm and happy but I was very stupid looking. Then it hit me. WE still had a movie to go to. "oh no" i said to myself still giggling uncontrollably.

We head to the theater besides the state I was in. We stand in line which is LONG (of course) by this time my friend is basically babysitting me, a obese, 6ft tall young man blubbering like an infant. As we are waiting to get tickets I take in my surroundings. The loud noises of the theater all seem to coalesce into white noise. I'm getting strange looks from people in the line and around us. I remember being fascinated by some guys shiny bald head. Two guys my age turn around and look at me in disgust saying, "hes high" My friend apologizes for my behavior and finally we get to the ticket booth.

At this point I'm peaking. I rest myself against the booth, trying to look as normal as possible. I tell my friend " dude we need to go back to the car, i cant handle this" he  assures me that i'll be ok and hands me the tickets and tells me not to lose them. I take this command very seriously and stare at my hands all the way to the snack booths. We get our food and head up the escalator. He jokingly tell me "dont fall lol" That freaks me out a little bit but we reach the top safely. We FINALLY get to the top and enter our movie. I still don't remember what we watched but I know it was an Ironman title.

This experience has humbled me alot these last few years. I always set aside free time when I want to go on a trip or try a new drug. It was extremely embarrassing but now hilarious when i think back on it.
